mapper.select: INSERT INTO tb_purchase_receipt_hd ( tenant_id, receipt_no, receipt_dt, supplier_id, receiver_id, receiver_dept_id, currency_code, tax_type, vat_included_at, supply_amt, vat_amt, total_amt, remark, created_by ) SELECT t.tenant_id, #{receiptNo}, CAST(#{receiptDt} AS date), #{supplierId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{receiverId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{receiverDeptId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{currencyCode}, #{taxType}, #{vatIncludedAt}, #{supplyAmt, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{vatAmt, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{totalAmt, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{remark}, #{createdBy} FROM tb_tenant t WHERE t.tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT} RETURNING purchase_receipt_id

INSERT INTO tb_purchase_receipt_dt ( purchase_receipt_id, tenant_id, line_no, purchase_arrival_detail_id, arrival_no, quality_inspection_detail_id, inspection_no, purchase_order_detail_id, material_id, receipt_qty, unit_price, supply_amt, vat_amt, total_amt, warehouse_id, manufacture_dt, expire_dt, lot_no, remark, created_by ) VALUES ( #{purchaseReceiptId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{lineNo}, #{purchaseArrivalDetailId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{arrivalNo}, #{qualityInspectionDetailId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{inspectionNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{purchaseOrderDetailId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{materialId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{receiptQty, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{unitPrice, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{supplyAmt, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{vatAmt, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{totalAmt, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{warehouseId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, CAST(#{manufactureDt, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS date), CAST(#{expireDt, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS date), #{lotNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{remark}, #{createdBy} ) RETURNING purchase_receipt_detail_id

SELECT rh.purchase_receipt_id AS purchaseReceiptId, rh.receipt_no AS receiptNo, rh.receipt_dt AS receiptDt, rh.supplier_id AS supplierId, rh.currency_code AS currencyCode, rh.tax_type AS taxType, rh.vat_included_at AS vatIncludedAt, rh.use_at AS useAt FROM tb_purchase_receipt_hd rh WHERE rh.purchase_receipt_id = #{purchaseReceiptId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND rh.tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT} FOR UPDATE OF rh
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_purchase_receipt_hd SET receipt_dt = CAST(#{receiptDt} AS date), tax_type = #{taxType}, vat_included_at = #{vatIncludedAt}, supply_amt = #{supplyAmt, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, vat_amt = #{vatAmt, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, total_amt = #{totalAmt, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, remark = #{remark}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = now() WHERE purchase_receipt_id = #{purchaseReceiptId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND use_at = 'Y'

UPDATE tb_purchase_receipt_dt SET line_no = #{lineNo}, receipt_qty = #{receiptQty, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, unit_price = #{unitPrice, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, supply_amt = #{supplyAmt, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, vat_amt = #{vatAmt, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, total_amt = #{totalAmt, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, warehouse_id = #{warehouseId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, manufacture_dt = CAST(#{manufactureDt, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS date), expire_dt = CAST(#{expireDt, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS date), remark = #{remark}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = now() WHERE purchase_receipt_detail_id = #{purchaseReceiptDetailId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND purchase_receipt_id = #{purchaseReceiptId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT}

UPDATE tb_purchase_receipt_hd SET use_at = 'N', updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = now() WHERE purchase_receipt_id = #{purchaseReceiptId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND use_at = 'Y'
mapper.select: SELECT rh.purchase_receipt_id AS purchaseReceiptId, rh.receipt_no AS receiptNo, rh.receipt_dt AS receiptDt, rh.supplier_id AS supplierId, c.customer_code AS supplierCode, c.customer_name AS supplierName, u.user_nm AS receiverName, rh.currency_code AS currencyCode, rh.tax_type AS taxType, rh.vat_included_at AS vatIncludedAt, rh.supply_amt AS supplyAmt, rh.vat_amt AS vatAmt, rh.total_amt AS totalAmt, rh.remark AS remark, rh.use_at AS useAt, rh.created_by AS createdBy, rh.created_at AS createdAt, rh.updated_by AS updatedBy, rh.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM tb_purchase_receipt_hd rh LEFT JOIN tb_customer_info c ON c.customer_id = rh.supplier_id AND c.tenant_id = rh.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON u.user_id = rh.receiver_id WHERE rh.purchase_receipt_id = #{purchaseReceiptId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND rh.tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT}

SELECT rd.purchase_receipt_detail_id AS purchaseReceiptDetailId, rd.line_no AS lineNo, rd.purchase_arrival_detail_id AS purchaseArrivalDetailId, ad.purchase_arrival_id AS purchaseArrivalId, ah.use_at AS arrivalActive, ad.inspect_at AS inspectAt, rd.arrival_no AS arrivalNo, rd.quality_inspection_detail_id AS qualityInspectionDetailId, rd.inspection_no AS inspectionNo, rd.purchase_order_detail_id AS purchaseOrderDetailId, oh.order_no AS orderNo, rd.material_id AS materialId, m.material_code AS materialCode, m.material_name AS materialName, m.material_spec AS materialSpec, m.unit AS unit, od.order_qty AS orderQty, od.order_qty - COALESCE((SELECT sum(a2.arrival_qty) FROM tb_purchase_arrival_dt a2 JOIN tb_purchase_arrival_hd ah2 ON ah2.purchase_arrival_id = a2.purchase_arrival_id AND ah2.tenant_id = a2.tenant_id WHERE a2.purchase_order_detail_id = rd.purchase_order_detail_id AND ah2.tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND ah2.use_at = 'Y' AND (rd.purchase_arrival_detail_id IS NULL OR a2.purchase_arrival_detail_id <> rd.purchase_arrival_detail_id)), 0) + COALESCE((SELECT sum(fd.fail_qty) FROM tb_quality_inspection_dt fd JOIN tb_quality_inspection_hd ih ON ih.quality_inspection_id = fd.quality_inspection_id AND ih.tenant_id = fd.tenant_id WHERE fd.purchase_order_detail_id = rd.purchase_order_detail_id AND ih.tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND ih.use_at = 'Y' AND fd.purchase_arrival_detail_id IS NOT NULL AND (rd.purchase_arrival_detail_id IS NULL OR fd.purchase_arrival_detail_id <> rd.purchase_arrival_detail_id)), 0) AS remainQty, ad.arrival_qty AS arrivalQty, CASE WHEN rd.quality_inspection_detail_id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE idt.pass_qty - COALESCE((SELECT sum(r2.receipt_qty) FROM tb_purchase_receipt_dt r2 JOIN tb_purchase_receipt_hd rh2 ON rh2.purchase_receipt_id = r2.purchase_receipt_id AND rh2.tenant_id = r2.tenant_id WHERE r2.quality_inspection_detail_id = rd.quality_inspection_detail_id AND rh2.tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND rh2.use_at = 'Y' AND rh2.purchase_receipt_id <> rd.purchase_receipt_id), 0) END AS receivableQty, rd.receipt_qty AS receiptQty, rd.unit_price AS unitPrice, rd.supply_amt AS supplyAmt, rd.vat_amt AS vatAmt, rd.total_amt AS totalAmt, rd.warehouse_id AS warehouseId, w.warehouse_name AS warehouseName, rd.manufacture_dt AS manufactureDt, rd.expire_dt AS expireDt, rd.lot_no AS lotNo, rd.remark AS remark, rd.closing_month AS closingMonth FROM tb_purchase_receipt_dt rd LEFT JOIN tb_purchase_arrival_dt ad ON ad.purchase_arrival_detail_id = rd.purchase_arrival_detail_id LEFT JOIN tb_purchase_arrival_hd ah ON ah.purchase_arrival_id = ad.purchase_arrival_id AND ah.tenant_id = ad.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_quality_inspection_dt idt ON idt.quality_inspection_detail_id = rd.quality_inspection_detail_id JOIN tb_purchase_order_dt od ON od.purchase_order_detail_id = rd.purchase_order_detail_id JOIN tb_purchase_order_hd oh ON oh.purchase_order_id = od.purchase_order_id AND oh.tenant_id = od.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_material_info m ON m.material_id = rd.material_id AND m.tenant_id = rd.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_warehouse w ON w.warehouse_id = rd.warehouse_id WHERE rd.purchase_receipt_id = #{purchaseReceiptId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND rd.tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT} ORDER BY rd.line_no
mapper.sql: FROM tb_quality_inspection_dt idt JOIN tb_quality_inspection_hd ih ON ih.quality_inspection_id = idt.quality_inspection_id AND ih.tenant_id = idt.tenant_id JOIN tb_purchase_arrival_dt ad ON ad.purchase_arrival_detail_id = idt.purchase_arrival_detail_id JOIN tb_purchase_arrival_hd ah ON ah.purchase_arrival_id = ad.purchase_arrival_id AND ah.tenant_id = ad.tenant_id JOIN tb_purchase_order_dt od ON od.purchase_order_detail_id = idt.purchase_order_detail_id JOIN tb_purchase_order_hd oh ON oh.purchase_order_id = od.purchase_order_id AND oh.tenant_id = od.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_customer_info c ON c.customer_id = ah.supplier_id AND c.tenant_id = ah.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_material_info m ON m.material_id = idt.material_id AND m.tenant_id = idt.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_warehouse w ON w.warehouse_id = ad.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN rcv ON rcv.quality_inspection_detail_id = idt.quality_inspection_detail_id WHERE idt.tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND ih.use_at = 'Y' AND ah.use_at = 'Y' AND idt.pass_qty - COALESCE(rcv.received_qty, 0) > 0
mapper.select:
SELECT idt.quality_inspection_detail_id AS qualityInspectionDetailId, ih.quality_inspection_id AS qualityInspectionId, ih.inspection_no AS inspectionNo, ih.inspection_dt AS inspectionDt, idt.purchase_arrival_detail_id AS purchaseArrivalDetailId, idt.arrival_no AS arrivalNo, ah.supplier_id AS supplierId, c.customer_code AS supplierCode, c.customer_name AS supplierName, ah.currency_code AS currencyCode, ah.tax_type AS taxType, ah.vat_included_at AS vatIncludedAt, idt.purchase_order_detail_id AS purchaseOrderDetailId, oh.order_no AS orderNo, idt.material_id AS materialId, m.material_code AS materialCode, m.material_name AS materialName, m.material_spec AS materialSpec, m.unit AS unit, idt.pass_qty AS passQty, COALESCE(rcv.received_qty, 0) AS receivedQty, idt.pass_qty - COALESCE(rcv.received_qty, 0) AS receivableQty, ad.unit_price AS unitPrice, ad.warehouse_id AS warehouseId, w.warehouse_name AS warehouseName, ad.manufacture_dt AS manufactureDt, ad.expire_dt AS expireDt
AND ih.inspection_dt >= CAST(#{fromDt} AS date)
AND ih.inspection_dt <= CAST(#{toDt} AS date)
AND (ih.inspection_no ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR idt.arrival_no ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR oh.order_no ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR c.customer_name ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR m.material_code ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR m.material_name ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%')
ORDER BY ih.inspection_dt DESC, ih.inspection_no DESC, idt.line_no LIMIT 500

SELECT idt.quality_inspection_detail_id AS qualityInspectionDetailId, ih.quality_inspection_id AS qualityInspectionId, ih.use_at AS inspectionUseAt, ih.inspection_no AS inspectionNo, idt.purchase_arrival_detail_id AS purchaseArrivalDetailId, ad.purchase_arrival_id AS purchaseArrivalId, ah.use_at AS arrivalUseAt, idt.arrival_no AS arrivalNo, ah.supplier_id AS supplierId, ah.currency_code AS currencyCode, idt.purchase_order_detail_id AS purchaseOrderDetailId, idt.material_id AS materialId, m.material_code AS materialCode, m.material_name AS materialName, idt.pass_qty AS passQty, COALESCE(rcv.received_qty, 0) AS receivedQty FROM tb_quality_inspection_dt idt JOIN tb_quality_inspection_hd ih ON ih.quality_inspection_id = idt.quality_inspection_id AND ih.tenant_id = idt.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_purchase_arrival_dt ad ON ad.purchase_arrival_detail_id = idt.purchase_arrival_detail_id LEFT JOIN tb_purchase_arrival_hd ah ON ah.purchase_arrival_id = ad.purchase_arrival_id AND ah.tenant_id = ad.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_material_info m ON m.material_id = idt.material_id AND m.tenant_id = idt.tenant_id LEFT JOIN rcv ON rcv.quality_inspection_detail_id = idt.quality_inspection_detail_id WHERE idt.tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND idt.quality_inspection_detail_id IN #{id, jdbcType=BIGINT} ORDER BY idt.quality_inspection_detail_id
FOR UPDATE OF idt, ih
